title: Database performance
intro: Track database calls, spot slow operations, and understand failures.
sampled: Metrics cover retained, recorded calls in the selected receipt window. Sampling and dropped events can affect these figures; these are not database-wide totals.
setup: Wrap a database call with the Node SDK traceQuery helper, or report a measured duration with captureQuery. Use static operation names; SQL text, parameters, and results are not collected by these helpers.
groupsHint: Top 100 operation groups, ordered by their combined time. The 95th percentile is the duration below which approximately 95% of recorded calls fall.
name: Operation name
recentHint: Latest 25 recorded calls in this window. Slow counts use durations greater than or equal to the selected threshold.
